en.title: Telethon children today live their dreams
en.summary: A documentary brings together former Telethon patients who are now adults and share their personal achievements and life experiences.

en.title: The Last First, at the peak of ego
en.summary: Director Amir Bar-Lev has made a film recreating a 2021 expedition to K2 that resulted in five deaths.

stories.title: El Subcomandante Marcos llega al Festival de Morelia

en.title: Subcomandante Marcos arrives at Morelia Festival
en.summary: A documentary about Zapatism features testimonies from notable figures including Oliver Stone and premiered at the festival.

stories.title: Kate del Castillo se prepara para dirigir

en.title: Kate del Castillo prepares to direct
en.summary: The actress is seeking investors to film her novel about domestic violence, titled Tuya: a storm of passion and cruelty.

stories.title: Arturo Chacón cantará en la "Tosca", de Puccini, en Bellas Artes

en.title: Arturo Chacón will sing in Puccini's "Tosca" at Bellas Artes
en.summary: The tenor will perform the role of Cavaradossi in the opera production at the venue.

stories.title: Avalan reforma vs doble nacionalidad de los candidatos

en.title: Opposition supports reform against dual nationality of candidates
en.summary: Forty-two opposition senators voted against an amendment, arguing it infringes on rights.

stories.title: Morena lanza convocatoria para quienes aspiren a una diputación federal; proceso concluye el 2 de octubre

en.title: Morena launches call for candidates aspiring to federal deputy positions; process concludes on October 2
en.summary: The Morena party opened a recruitment process for individuals interested in running for federal deputy positions, with applications closing on October 2.

stories.title: Embajador Lazzeri defiende reforma contra doble nacionalidad; ese requisito ya se pide en el servicio exterior, explica

en.title: Ambassador Lazzeri defends reform against dual nationality; this requirement is already requested in foreign service, explains
en.summary: Ambassador Lazzeri defended a dual nationality reform on social media, noting that holding dual nationality does not diminish someone's Mexican identity and that the requirement already exists in the foreign service.

stories.title: Polo toca tierra en Guaymas, Sonora como huracán categoría 1; sigue en vivo los efectos de este fenómeno

en.title: Polo touches ground in Guaymas, Sonora as category 1 hurricane; follow live the effects of this phenomenon
en.summary: Tropical Storm Rachel is moving toward Mexico's Pacific coast, bringing heavy rainfall and high waves to areas including Michoacán.

stories.title: Se logrará reforma sobre doble nacionalidad: Morena

en.title: Reform on dual nationality will be achieved: Morena
en.summary: The parliamentary coordinator of Morena in the Senate expressed confidence that the group has the necessary votes to pass a constitutional reform on dual nationality, scheduled for a Senate vote.

stories.title: Polo toca tierra en BCS como huracán categoría 2

en.title: Polo makes landfall in BCS as Category 2 hurricane
en.summary: Hurricane Polo made landfall early Tuesday near Las Barrancas in Comondú municipality, Baja California Sur, as a Category 2 hurricane on the Saffir-Simpson scale.

stories.title: Concluye Morena su proceso interno con triunfos claves del PVEM

en.title: Morena concludes internal process with key victories for PVEM
en.summary: Morena appointed the remaining seven candidates for states holding governorship elections next year, with the Green Party winning races in Baja California Sur and Nayarit.

stories.title: Clientes llevan un año sin sus joyas por la huelga del Monte de Piedad y reclaman: “No quiero perderlas”

en.title: Customers have been without their jewelry for a year due to Monte de Piedad strike and demand: "I don't want to lose them"
en.summary: A strike at Nacional Monte de Piedad is approaching one year in duration, with customers still seeking recovery of items left at branch locations.

stories.title: Reforma a la inversión extranjera llega al pleno del Senado entre críticas por sus filtros

en.title: Foreign investment reform reaches Senate floor amid criticism over its filters
en.summary: A foreign investment reform proposal is advancing to the Senate with debate over screening mechanisms. Morena defends the filters as protecting sovereignty while opposition and some lawmakers warn of investment uncertainty.

stories.title: México quiere emular a Brasil y masificar en un año los pagos digitales

en.title: Mexico seeks to emulate Brazil and massify digital payments in one year
en.summary: Mexico aims to reduce cash usage to 50% by 2027 by expanding digital payment tools like CoDi and DiMo. The challenge involves transitioning these systems from infrastructure into everyday consumer use.

stories.title: ¿Pagarás impuestos al SAT por pagos digitales? Esto es lo que debes saber de la iniciativa de Ley

en.title: Will you pay taxes to SAT for digital payments? What you need to know about the law initiative
en.summary: A proposed Digital Economy Law does not establish direct taxation on digital payments, though using these methods creates financial transaction records in the banking system.

stories.title: Nu México nombra a Estephany Paulette Ley como CEO

en.title: Nu México appoints Estephany Paulette Ley as CEO
en.summary: Estephany Paulette Ley has been named CEO of Nu México, becoming the second woman to lead a bank in the country. She brings extensive experience from Mexico's financial sector.
